presentation.label: QUICK FILL COND
presentation.summary: Hold a trig in GRID RECORDING and press FILL to lock its trig condition: FILL, NOT FILL, then no lock.
presentation.overview: Set a fill trig without going to the TRC knob. In GRID RECORDING, hold one or more trigs and press FILL: the trigs get a FILL condition lock. Press again for NOT FILL, and again to remove the lock. The press does not engage fill, and a fill latched with FUNC + FILL plays out its loop.
highlights: One press for FILL, a second for NOT FILL, a third to clear
Works on every held trig at once
FILL keeps its stock job when no trig is held
usage: Mark a trig as a fill-only hit while the pattern plays.
Hold two trigs to swap them between FILL and NOT FILL together.

access.location: Any trig key held in GRID RECORDING, then FILL.
steps: Hold a trig and press FILL: the trig plays only in fill.
Press FILL again for NOT FILL, a third time to clear it.

limitations: Works in GRID RECORDING only: outside it, LIVE RECORDING included, and with QPER held or a menu open, FILL stays stock's.
Any other condition on the trig is replaced, and stock has no undo for it.

load.conditions: Measure with every track playing, parameters modulated and the mod at its heaviest setting.

tests.summary: Functional pass on an Analog Rytm MKII and rytm-emu; see TESTING.md.
